summary: Iteration 7 - Obligations (Öhdəliklər) Module Complete Testing: All 18 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working: Obligations page with table, stats cards, CRUD operations, quick status change, filters, search, overdue highlighting.

issues: Minor: DialogContent missing aria-describedby (console warning only, not user-facing)

Backend: GET /api/obligations?status=Gözləyir filters by status
Backend: GET /api/obligations/stats returns correct counts (total, pending, in_progress, completed, overdue)
Backend: POST /api/obligations creates new obligation with all fields
Backend: POST /api/obligations supports all 8 obligation types (Maliyyə, Xidmət, Çatdırılma, Hüquqi, Tədbir, Təlim, Layihə, Digər)
Backend: PUT /api/obligations/{id} updates obligation
Backend: PUT /api/obligations/{id} with status=Tamamlandı sets completion_date
Backend: PUT /api/obligations/{id} returns 404 for non-existent obligation
Backend: DELETE /api/obligations/{id} deletes obligation
Backend: DELETE /api/obligations/{id} returns 404 for non-existent obligation
Backend: Overdue obligations (deadline < today AND status not Tamamlandı/Ləğv edildi) counted in stats.overdue
Backend: Completed obligations not counted as overdue even if deadline passed
Backend: Existing obligations in DB have correct structure
Backend: GET /api/obligations requires authentication (401 without token)
Backend: GET /api/obligations/stats requires authentication
Backend: POST /api/obligations requires authentication
Backend: GET /api/options/companies returns companies for dropdown
Backend: GET /api/options/all returns marsol_representatives for responsible person dropdown
Frontend: Obligations page loads at /obligations with data-testid
Frontend: Stats cards show Cəmi, Gözləyir, İcrada, Tamamlandı, Vaxtı keçmiş
Frontend: Table shows obligations with all columns (Öhdəlik, Şirkət, Tip, Məsul, Son tarix, Prioritet, Status, Əməliyyat)
Frontend: Add Obligation button opens modal with all fields
Frontend: Create obligation via modal works (toast: Öhdəlik yaradıldı)
Frontend: Edit obligation via pencil button works (toast: Öhdəlik yeniləndi)
Frontend: Delete obligation via trash button works with confirmation (toast: Öhdəlik silindi)
Frontend: Quick status change via dropdown in status column works (toast: Status: İcrada)
Frontend: Overdue obligations show red deadline text and days count (e.g., '420 gün keçib')
Frontend: Search by title works
Frontend: Filter panel shows Status, Tip, Məsul, Prioritet dropdowns
Frontend: Sidebar shows Öhdəliklər menu item with FileCheck icon
seed_data_creation: Test obligations created and cleaned up during tests. 2 existing obligations in DB: 'Müqavilə yenilənməsi' (İcrada, overdue) and 'Sərgi hazırlığı' (Gözləyir, overdue)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Obligations module fully implemented and tested. Key features: 1) Obligations page at /obligations with table view, stats cards, filters, search. 2) CRUD operations via modal (create/edit) and inline buttons (delete). 3) Quick status change via dropdown in status column - supports Gözləyir, İcrada, Tamamlandı, Ləğv edildi. 4) When status changed to Tamamlandı, completion_date is auto-set (frontend sends it). 5) Overdue detection: deadline < today AND status not Tamamlandı/Ləğv edildi - shows red text and 'X gün keçib'. 6) Stats endpoint calculates overdue count server-side. 7) Types: Maliyyə, Xidmət, Çatdırılma, Hüquqi, Tədbir, Təlim, Layihə, Digər. 8) Form uses /api/options/companies for company dropdown and /api/options/all for marsol_representatives. 9) Sidebar shows Öhdəliklər with FileCheck icon. 10) 2 test obligations exist in DB (both overdue by 400+ days).

obligations_page.details: Page loads at /obligations with table, stats cards, search, filters. All data-testid attributes present.

stats_cards.details: 5 stats cards: Cəmi (total), Gözləyir (pending), İcrada (in_progress), Tamamlandı (completed), Vaxtı keçmiş (overdue). Values update correctly after CRUD operations.

obligations_crud.details: Create via modal with all fields (title, description, company, type, responsible, deadline, priority, status, notes). Edit via pencil button. Delete via trash button with confirmation dialog.

quick_status_change.details: Inline dropdown in status column. Click to open, select new status. Toast shows 'Status: [new status]'. When Tamamlandı selected, completion_date auto-set.

overdue_highlighting.details: Overdue obligations (deadline < today AND status not Tamamlandı/Ləğv edildi) show red deadline text and 'X gün keçib' indicator.

search_and_filters.details: Search by title, company name, or responsible person. Filter by status, type, responsible person, priority. Clear filters button works.

sidebar_menu.details: Öhdəliklər menu item with FileCheck icon in sidebar. Navigates to /obligations.
